text:
olivia: Quick sync — customer ACME asked for an upgrade path for Private VPC packaging with near-zero downtime. Field specifically requested: mixed-version nodes during rollout, IP preservation, deterministic rollback window. Need to decide scope and launch criteria. cc @dennis @sam_p

sam_p: We can support mixed-version at the infra/orchestration layer if images are backwards-compatible. Biggest risk is KV cache format mismatch causing session incoherence. Fallback to stateless inference should be a hard requirement.

dennis: On model-serving: KV cache format changed in 0.8.2; older runtime can't read the new format. Options: (A) enforce all nodes to migrate caches on start, (B) provide a compatibility shim, (C) evict caches during upgrade and run stateless until warmed. Migration adds ~30s/node.

maya_sre: Customer SLA is ~1m/node downtime allowed. A 30s migration could be fine if done in parallel batches, but network affinity / client stickiness can extend perceived outage. Also need to preserve client IPs for licensing checks. Recommend sticky sessions + `--drain-connections` flag in playbook. :warning:

alex_p: From PM side, proposed launch criteria: 1) automated rollback path (can revert batch), 2) migration dry-run with metrics, 3) ops playbook + Console visibility (start/pause/rollback). Prioritize this as P2 for Q2 planning — field pressure but non-blocking for broader customers.

olivia: Proposed MVP scope: allow mixed-version nodes for the same model family only, add an opt-in `migrate-caches` flag that does a cache-format migration on node start, and auto-evict incompatible KV entries as a fallback. If we accept that, we can target a gated rollout.

sam_p: Tech tasks I see: - expose health endpoint `GET /health/compat` (returns compatible_versions + incompatible_keys) - CLI `migrate-caches --dry-run` (prints estimated time) - metrics: `cache_migrate_duration_seconds`, `cache_evictions_total`

dennis: Tests: cross-version correctness tests + perf regression harness. Also add a seeded-eval prompt set so we can detect quality regressions when falling back to stateless mode.

maya_sre: Ops playbook draft (WIP) — placeholder link: https://internal.redwood/intern/ops/vpc-upgrade-playbook. Add runbook sections: pre-checks, canary batch size, rollback steps, customer comms template. Will add `--drain-connections` and IP-preservation checklist.

infra-bot: deploy-plan-generator completed quick estimate: 12 nodes total, staged rollout with parallel batches of 3 -> ~2hr total walltime (includes migration + verification).

olivia: Timeline ask: can we ship feature-gated mixed-version + health endpoint + playbook in 3 sprints? (3 x 2-week sprints)

sam_p: Yes for feature gate + health endpoint in 2 sprints, migrate tooling + metrics in sprint 3. Need a +1 from infra for staging automation.

alex_p: Field also asked for Console UX: simple "Start upgrade" button, batch progress bars, per-tenant logs. UX writer/PM to mock.

maya_sre: I'll own playbook and QA the runbook steps during the staging run.

olivia: Action items recap: @sam_p -> tech design PR + health endpoint, @dennis -> compatibility matrix & tests, @maya_sre -> ops playbook + runbook QA, @alex_p -> Console mockups + field comms. Reconvene Tue 09:00 for decision on scope & canary size. :thumbsup:
